meta.title: HardPT: stratified samples and prompt-based training

system.name: HardPT
system.one_liner: hard-sample-aware prompt tuning: sort training sentences into easy, hard and misleading, train on the hard ones with positive and negative samples, leave the misleading ones out

materials: the three review sentences with their labels and the model's predictions (Table 1 of the paper)
one positive and one negative sample sentence for the hard case
ai.notes: two lettered panels stacked: (a) the data triage read left to right through four framed columns joined by block chevrons; (b) the training diagram, the EASY frame in the top row with encoder, MLM head and loss, the wide HARD frame along the bottom with its positive and negative sample rows

meta.caption_draft: Figure 1. (a) Training sentences with their labels and the model's predictions are stratified into EASY (green), HARD (gold) and MISLEADING (red) samples. (b) Easy and hard samples are wrapped in a cloze template and run through the frozen encoder and MLM head into the adaptive contrastive loss; the hard sample is joined by positive (P) and negative (N) samples, while misleading samples are left out.
open_questions: Does the misleading stratum appear in (b) at all (greyed out), or only in (a)?
Are the positive and negative samples drawn for the easy input too, or only for the hard one?
meta._notes: Captured: the one colour code that ties the two panels (green / gold / red for the three strata, carried from the predictions in (a) into the card titles and the dashed flow arrows of (b)), the real example sentences as text nodes with their lines, the cloze template as a prompt-box idiom, the positive and negative sample rows as the contrastive-pair idiom with a count, the encoder and MLM head drawn as cylinders (the paper's choice, kept through `symbol`), and the two dashed flows that share the encoder, head and loss. Not captured as geometry: the exact widths of the four columns of (a), the bracket labels 'Input & Template' under the cards, the ellipses between the sample boxes. The record notes that the colour meaning is given only in the caption; the spec declares a legend so the figure can be read alone.
